behavioral.label: Auto-recall toggle
behavioral.evidence: toggleAutoRecall calls voxTransport.setGuiPreference('gui.memory.autoRecall', ...) and updates local state; hydrated from DB on mount via getGuiPreference

behavioral.label: Reindex button
behavioral.evidence: Calls invoke('mnemosyne_reindex') directly; Command function confirmed to exist in crates/vox-gui/src-tauri/src/commands/memory.rs:L206; registration in generate_handler![] not yet verified but risk reduced.

behavioral.label: Recall button / Enter key
behavioral.evidence: recall() calls invoke<SearchResponse>('vox_search_query', { query, scope, limit }) and updates hits state; Enter key (line 346) also dispatches recall()

behavioral.label: Recent recall row click
behavioral.evidence: onClick sets query and immediately calls recall(r.q) which invokes vox_search_query

behavioral.label: Pin all to context button
behavioral.evidence: pinHits() calls attachItemsFromHits then onAttachContext(items); honestly warns via pushToast if items are empty or onAttachContext is absent — no silent noop

behavioral.label: HitCard per-item pin button
behavioral.evidence: Calls onPin() which is () => pinHits([h]) — same honest pinHits path as 'Pin all'

behavioral.label: HitCard open button
behavioral.evidence: openHit() calls voxTransport.openLocator(hit.locator) for file/web locators; errors surface via pushToast

behavioral.label: Corpus scope chip toggle
behavioral.evidence: toggleScope updates local scope state array; auto-recall useEffect re-triggers recall when scope changes if recallOn

visual.issue: Score bar uses raw Tailwind palette tokens 'from-violet-400 to-emerald-400' instead of design-system semantic tokens
Pin-all button uses raw 'border-cyan-400/30 bg-cyan-400/10 text-cyan-300' instead of ds semantic tokens
Dirty shard card uses raw 'border-amber-400/30 bg-amber-400/[0.04]' instead of ds semantic tokens
Dirty shard badge uses raw 'bg-amber-400/15 text-amber-300' instead of ds semantic tokens
Recent recall row chevron icon (Icon.chevR) has no aria-hidden attribute; will be read by screen readers as unlabeled icon
Section heading icon Icon.clock has no aria-hidden; read as unlabeled icon alongside the 'Recent recalls' heading
Recall button is styled with brass/40 border only when query is non-empty; when empty it blends with surrounding controls — disabled state styling reduces primary-action discoverability
